name: Bijacovce (Slovakia)
description: Divided diagonally from lower hoist to upper fly by a narrow yellow line, white above and blue below, ending at the fly in three tails formed by two swallowtail notches reaching one third of the flag's length.
history: The flag's colours are taken from the municipal arms, as required for Slovak municipal symbols; arms and flag are registered in the Heraldic Register of the Slovak Republic under signature B-20/1993.
